run_gpe_gpi_experiment: run a GPE/GPI experiment on task (1, -1) with w obtained by regression using a pre-trained keyboard model
load_keyboard_with_smartmodule: load a TensorFlow Hub keyboard model using SmartModuleImport for use in the scavenger environment
create_scavenger_environment: create a Scavenger environment with logging and keyboard wrappers for GPE/GPI experiments
create_regressed_agent: create a regressed agent with Adam optimizer and random normal initial weights for the keyboard cumulants
run_experiment_and_write_returns: run the experiment for a set number of episodes and optionally write EMA returns to a file
